messages:
chris (finance): Sunrise Capital still shows INV-2026-2375 for $54,900 overdue (due 2026-03-02). No remittance on file. Lina can you confirm if AE got a PTP?

lina (acct-exec): Pinged Dhar earlier. He replied procurement needs a signed change order to release funds; they're fast-tracking but treasury won't wire until the CO is in the system. I sent the CO to Dhar at 08:12 this morning.

dhar (Sunrise Capital AP): Apologies for the delay. Procurement required our legal team to sign the small change order (CO-442). Legal cleared it 30m ago; treasury scheduled a two-part transfer: 30% now and 70% once bank reconciliation completes tomorrow. I can upload remittance screenshot once ACH is queued.

chris (finance): We can accept a split if we get 30% ($16,470) posted by 2026-03-18 10:00 UTC with masked proof of payment. If full wires by 2026-03-19 EOD we'll waive the $300 reinstatement fee. Please include INV-2026-2375 in remittance ref.

lina (acct-exec): Also offered a one-time operational credit of $500 if Sunrise posts the full payment by 03/19. Dhar - confirm acceptance and we'll send the credit confirmation email.

dhar (Sunrise Capital AP): Confirmed. Sunrise accepts the $500 credit conditional on full payment by 03/19. We'll post 30% today and remainder tomorrow. I'll attach bank confirmation here once available (mask acct numbers).

marta (legal): Note: document the CO-442 and PTP in account notes. Per our collections playbook, if the second tranche misses the promised date we begin the 7-day demand letter timeline. Also check whether prior credits change our accrual treatment; I'll flag finance for that.

ops (platform): Heads-up: if account enters hold we will suspend background syncs for their enterprise connector; customer-facing API keys remain for 24h grace then throttle. I can prepare a re-enable checklist once payment clears; need transaction ref to match.

reminders-bot: Reminder: Billing hold scheduled for account "sunrise-capital" on 2026-03-18 10:00 UTC if outstanding balance > $0. Run `/payments check INV-2026-2375` to refresh.

chris (finance): Thanks. @lina once you have the masked remittance paste it here and I'll clear the pending hold and issue the credit confirmation email to Dhar with the $500 attached.

lina (acct-exec): Bank queue shows ACH initiated 03/18 08:45 UTC. Uploading masked remittance: "REMIT: ACH - ****9012 - INV-2026-2375 / CO-442 - AMT $16,470 - REF TXN-SC-5599"

dhar (Sunrise Capital AP): Bank confirms tranche 1 sent. We'll push tranche 2 tomorrow morning and post confirmation here. Thanks for the flexibility.

chris (finance): Received. Clearing temporary hold. I'll send the $500 credit confirmation email now and note CO-442 in the ledger. Keep thread updated if tranche 2 posts late. :white_check_mark:

marta (legal): Documented CO-442 and PTP in account. If tranche 2 misses 03/19 EOD we escalate per policy.

ops (platform): Will standby to re-enable paused syncs once ledger shows settled. Please include TXN-IDs in the final post so I can correlate.

reminders-bot: Payment INV-2026-2375 marked pending settlement. Use `/payments refresh 2198765432` to check final posting.

chris (finance): Closing thread pending settlement. Reopen if tranche 2 doesn't post by 2026-03-19 EOD. :v:
